wallet.heading: Put your member card in every member's phone.
wallet.sub: We build membership cards for Apple Wallet and Google Wallet. Each card issues itself when a member pays, and updates itself when their details change.
chips: A card page for any other phone
wallet.caption: Varsity Vipers Basketball Club membership card on Apple Wallet and Google Wallet. Member details are samples.

card.photoAlt: Varsity Vipers players in a game-day huddle

features.title: The card issues itself on payment.
features.body: A paid registration creates the member's card within minutes of checkout. Your committee never has to remember to send one.

features.title: The card updates itself overnight.
features.body: A nightly check compares every card with the member record and reissues only the cards that changed. A new age group or photo reaches the phone on its own.

features.title: The door check takes seconds.
features.body: Volunteers scan the QR code and see the member's current record. A cancelled card stops passing the check, so only current members get in.

features.title: The card shows only what the check needs.
features.body: Vipers cards show year of birth instead of date of birth, and every card link uses a random key. A screenshot of the card gives nothing away.

uses.heading: Where else can a wallet card work for you?
uses.sub: Anywhere people need to prove who they are, or what they have paid for. We set it up under your brand.

items.title: Gyms and studios
items.body: Members check in with a scan at reception. The pass shows their plan, and it renews itself when they pay.

items.title: Cafés and retail loyalty
items.body: A loyalty card sits beside the customer's bank cards. Points update after each visit, with no app to download.

items.title: Events and venues
items.body: Tickets and entry passes live in the phone's wallet and scan at the gate. A time change reaches every ticket holder at once.

items.title: Schools and training providers
items.body: A student pass proves enrolment on the spot. It expires when the course ends, so nobody has to chase old cards.

items.title: Clubs and associations
items.body: Members show proof of membership for entry and partner discounts. The committee issues and cancels cards from one member list.

items.title: Staff and volunteer ID
items.body: Staff carry a current ID that can be checked on site. Cancel a card and the next scan rejects it.

plugin.heading: Update your website by filling in a form.
plugin.sub: We build WordPress plugins around the content you change most. Your team fills in a simple form, and the page lays it out in your design.
plugin.caption: Homelessness Queensland website and its custom plugin. Screens show sample text and blurred images.

showcase.mainImageAlt: Course catalogue built by the plugin, with a filter, course cards and enrol buttons. Text is sample text.
showcase.sideImageAlt: Members-only resource library with topic, format and access filters. Text is sample text.

features.title: Staff add items without a page builder.
features.body: Each course, role or news story is a record with its own fields. Staff fill them in and the item appears in the approved layout.

features.title: Each feature switches on or off.
features.body: A Modules screen turns a feature off without deleting its content. You run only what you use, and nothing is lost if you want it back.

features.title: Members-only files take one tick.
features.body: Tick Members only on any file in the media library and it moves behind member login. Visitors who are not logged in go to the login page.

features.title: Every release is tested before it goes live.
features.body: Code is checked on three PHP versions and every version is tracked. Any change can be traced or rolled back.

uses.heading: What else could a custom plugin run for you?
uses.sub: Any content you add again and again. The same building blocks fit many kinds of business.

items.title: Careers and job boards
items.body: Add a paid or volunteer role through a form. It appears with its own apply section and job details Google can read.

items.title: Course and event catalogues
items.body: Courses sit in filterable tiles with online payment. Staff change dates and details in one place.

items.title: Member resource libraries
items.body: Members filter resources by topic, format and access. Any file can be locked to members with one tick.

items.title: News and updates hubs
items.body: Publish a post and it flows into a featured story and news cards. Categories keep updates easy to browse.

items.title: Project galleries for trades
items.body: Add a finished job with photos, suburb and service. The gallery filters itself, so customers find work like theirs.

items.title: Store and location directories
items.body: Each location gets its own page with hours and services. You update one store without touching the others.

items.question: What does I Love Digital do?
items.answer: I Love Digital builds websites, gets businesses found on Google and in AI search, and runs organic social media on Instagram, Facebook and TikTok. We also make digital wallet cards and custom WordPress plugins, and offer fractional CTO support. We work with small businesses on the Gold Coast and across Queensland, and you deal directly with the person doing the work.

items.question: Where is I Love Digital based?
items.answer: I Love Digital is based on the Gold Coast in Queensland, Australia. We work with clients across Queensland and Australia, with a focus on Gold Coast and Brisbane service businesses.

items.question: Who do you work with?
items.answer: We work primarily with Queensland trades and service businesses turning over $500,000 or more annually, with 3 to 50 employees — including solar installers, electricians, builders, retailers, and professional services.

items.question: What's different about working with I Love Digital?
items.answer: I Love Digital is run solo by Jerrell Niu, backed by two decades of product management, technology, and business experience. Clients work directly with the person doing the work, get faster turnarounds than a traditional agency, and pay less than they would for equivalent senior talent at a larger studio.

items.question: How much does a new website cost?
items.answer: Website pricing depends on platform, complexity, and ongoing requirements, so we don't publish a fixed price — get a free quote and we'll come back with clear, itemised pricing. Onboarding fees are always separate from any monthly retainer, and everything is quoted in Australian dollars.

items.question: What is AI Search (GEO)?
items.answer: GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation) is the practice of optimising a website so it can be found, understood, and cited by AI search engines and Google's AI Overviews. It sits on top of traditional SEO and is becoming critical as more searches move to AI platforms.
